sections.heading: 1. Light and Reflection
points: **Light travels in a straight line** (rectilinear propagation).
**Reflection** = the bouncing back of light from a surface.
A **plane mirror** (flat) forms an image that is: **virtual, erect, same size**, as far behind the mirror as the object is in front, and **laterally inverted** (left–right reversed).
**Lateral inversion** is why the word AMBULANCE is written reversed on vehicles.

sections.heading: 2. Spherical Mirrors
points: **Concave mirror** — reflecting surface curves **inward**; can form **real or virtual, magnified** images; **converges** light.
Uses of concave mirror: **shaving/make-up mirror, dentist's mirror, torch/headlight reflectors, solar cookers**.
**Convex mirror** — reflecting surface curves **outward**; always forms a **small, virtual, erect** image; gives a **wider field of view**.
Uses of convex mirror: **rear-view (side) mirrors** in vehicles.

sections.heading: 3. Lenses
points: **Convex (converging) lens** — thicker in the middle; **converges** light; can form real/virtual images; used as a **magnifying glass**, in spectacles for the far-sighted.
**Concave (diverging) lens** — thinner in the middle; **diverges** light; forms a small, virtual image; used in spectacles for the near-sighted.
A convex lens can **burn paper** by focusing sunlight to a point.

sections.heading: 4. White Light and Colours
points: **Sunlight (white light) is made of seven colours**: **VIBGYOR** — Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red.
A **prism** splits white light into these colours (**dispersion**); a **rainbow** forms the same way (water droplets).
**Newton's disc** — a disc painted with the seven colours appears **white** when spun rapidly (colours recombine).

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Light travels in straight lines; reflection = bouncing back.
Plane mirror image: virtual, erect, same size, laterally inverted.
Concave mirror = converging (shaving/dentist/headlight, solar cooker); convex mirror = diverging (rear-view, wide view).
Convex lens = converging (magnifying glass); concave lens = diverging.
White light = VIBGYOR (7 colours); prism disperses; Newton's disc appears white when spun.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: A **convex mirror** always gives a **small, virtual, erect** image (used as rear-view for wide view).
A **concave mirror** is used in **headlights/torches** and as a **shaving mirror**.
A **plane mirror** image is **laterally inverted** (left↔right), not upside down.
Order of colours in white light = **VIBGYOR**; a prism causes **dispersion**.
